scope.excluded: Ignored local state, credentials, caches, logs and deployment records

limits: The 114 binary assets were not text-scanned. New representative UI captures were visually inspected; unchanged historical captures were not all re-reviewed.
Relative paths were checked locally. This audit did not verify external-account access or all remote URLs.
Version 0.3.0 release and download links depended on the planned GitHub asset upload at audit time.
Human usability rehearsal and external-account copy/restore remain separate readiness gates.
This is a pattern-based privacy scan, not proof that every possible credential format is absent.

followup_review.clarification: docs/setup.md now says an editable hosted copy reads its project and credentials from Forge, rather than equating runtime credentials with the browser sign-in.
followup_review.cross_platform_scope: CI installs and automated checks are distinct from external-attendee end-to-end rehearsal. No cross-platform classroom-readiness claim was found.
followup_review.identity_scope: New editable hosted notebooks use the injected anchor identity; artifact collection remains an older-host fallback.
remaining_gates: Hosted read-only preview in the verification browser
